skill: Infer two elementary column additions that create two zeros in one row of a 3x3 matrix, using a specified unchanged pivot column.
reasoning_steps: Identify the unchanged column j and the row r with two zeros in B.
For each other column i calculate k_i=-a_ri/a_rj, with nonzero pivot.
Apply each operation to the whole column and check that the intermediate and final matrices match B.
Select the one correct pair among five radio choices.
invariants: 3x3 integer matrices, two nontrivial column additions sharing a nonzero pivot.
Two integer multipliers and a single correct pair; no swaps, scaling, row operations, systems solving, or 4x4 workload.
Worked solution identifies pivot location and shows both complete matrix transformations.
permitted_variations: Any of three pivot columns and three zeroed rows; all signs of nonzero integral multipliers.
Nonzero positive and negative pivots, including magnitudes greater than one with divisible entries.
Off-target entries may change without changing multipliers; changing a target-row entry must update multiplier and B.
Correct option position, multiplier magnitudes/order, distractor profiles and non-pivot column roles are incidental answer-bearing assignments, not fixed constraints.
